lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad ma(n)niai gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat kare sadaa saache kee liv laai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath man vasiaa naanak sahaj samaai ||4||19||52||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dukheee jug chaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hodaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan muthe aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sataguroo kiaa phitakiaa ma(n)g thake sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
lines.translation: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere sadaa har vekh hadoor ||
lines.translation: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh paraharai sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar ||
lines.translation: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu varatadaa koi na metanahaar ||
lines.translation: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mahal na paainee kooR muthe kooRiaar ||2||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa sukhadaataa daataar ||
lines.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur sevahi taa ubarahi sach rakhahi ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa te har paaeeai sach sabad veechaar ||3||
lines.translation: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod jeevat marai gur kai sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat rahi gae laagaa saach piaar ||
lines.translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach rate mukh ujale tit saachai darabaar ||4||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur purakh na ma(n)nio sabad na lago piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: isanaan daan jetaa karahi doojai bhaai khuaar ||
lines.translation: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu aapanee kripaa kare taa laagai naam piaar ||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar ||5||20||53||
lines.translation: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hau sevee kiaa jap karee satagur poochhau jaai ||
lines.translation: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n laee vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehaa sevaa chaakaree naam vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naamai hee te sukh paaeeai sachai sabad suhaai ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere anadin jaag har chet ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee khetee rakh lai koo(n)j paRaigee khet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat karahi din raatee har jeeu vekhai sadaa hadoor ||
lines.translation: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa man raataa bhram gaiaa sareerahu door ||
lines.translation: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: niramal saahib paaiaa saachaa gunee gaheer ||2||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaage se ubare soote gae muhaai ||
lines.translation: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad na pachhaanio supanaa gaiaa vihaai ||
lines.translation: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nje ghar kaa paahunaa jiu aaiaa tiu jaai ||
lines.translation: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.
